cell.readout: Plurality vote over the 4 samples per problem (cap hits cast no vote), right under grader v3, out of the 164 problems of shard 0/2.
cell.why: This keeps the autobench cap (4,096) but swaps the plain prompt for the cue. Under a the cap sets the ceiling, so the cued vote stays near the autobench level (139/328, about 70 of 164) or below. Under b the cue removes the agreeing wrong answers, so the vote nears the uncapped cued one-sample level (about 82 of 164).

Under a, the quick errors are unswitched plain-register samples, which the cue switches, so the count falls near the cued base's level. cell.command: uv run tools/gpu.py submit l40s --hours 2 -- "bash studies/rlneurons/jobs/setup_vllm.sh && /opt/rln-vllm/bin/python -m studies.theory.jobs.free_cell --model base --set math500 --n 100 --temperature 0.6 --top-p 1.0 --max-tokens 16384 --samples 4 --seed 71000000 --commit $(git rev-parse HEAD)"
cell.readout: Per problem, plurality vote over the 4 samples' v3 extracted answers, grouped with rln4_lib.agree; cap hits and empty extractions count as no answer, and ties go to the lowest sample index. A = vote right of 100 using the full answers. B = the same vote with every sample whose generated tokens exceed 4,096 counted as no answer (equal to a run capped at 4,096). Readout = A - B.
cell.unit: right answers of 100 (signed difference, paired on the same text)
cell.why: Mechanism a says the 4,096 cap cut right answers out of the vote, so lifting it adds several problems. Mechanism b says the plain prompt's correlated errors set the ceiling, so answers past 4,096 tokens are mostly loops or wrong, and lifting the cap adds about nothing.

cell.command: uv run tools/gpu.py submit l40s --hours 2 -- "bash studies/rlneurons/jobs/setup_vllm.sh && rm -rf /tmp/theta && /opt/rln-vllm/bin/python -m studies.rlneurons.jobs.wsp_edit --recipe top8 --other rl_code --scale 0.5 --rounding stochastic --seed 0 --dir /tmp/theta && /opt/rln-vllm/bin/python -m studies.rlneurons.jobs.run_code_cell --model-path /tmp/theta --model-label code_top8x0.5 --prefix-ids '<Code cue ids, as in results/xreward/code_dial run.json>' --temperature 1.0 --top-p 1.0 --seed 51000000 --commit $(git rev-parse HEAD)"
cell.readout: problems passed of 538 (also cap hits and answers with no code block)
cell.why: Under a, a saturating mode switch, 0.5x already flips most samples and keeps most of 1x's gain. Under b, the format part is full at 0.5x but the correctness part is only about a third of its 1.5x size, so the gain stops near the format-only count. Both expect cap hits and no-block answers to have fallen mostly, so the pass count separates them.
